training_patches: One randomly offset ball-containing crop and one randomly selected fixed-grid crop with no reference ball overlap per eligible source image. No resizing. Unknown ball frames are not negatives.
validation_patches: All fixed-grid tiles of eligible source images; crop locations never use reference ball position. Clip reference boxes at tile boundaries. Patches are validation proxies only; full-frame comparison is required.
baseline: Original Nano COCO, confidence 0.3, SAHI 512x768 and overlap 0.2.
candidate: Dedicated ball ID 0, SAHI 384x384 and overlap 0.2, raw threshold 0.05; GREEDYNMM IOS 0.5, class-aware, standard full-frame prediction included. Post-merge operating threshold selected only on validation.
selection: Best training epoch by fixed-grid validation mAP. On full validation images, among operating thresholds retaining all baseline matched boxes, select fewest unmatched predictions, then most matches, then larger threshold. Freeze threshold before recheck inference/scoring.
acceptance: Both validation and fixed recheck must preserve all baseline matches and reduce unmatched predictions >=20 percent. Positive baseline match and unmatched counts required. Passing permits expanded external validation only, not final possession integration.
limits: New sequences within the same previously exposed games, not independent new matches. Ball-present-only reference coverage; unannotated extra balls may exist. No possession, temporal tracking, absent-ball or two-camera accuracy claim.
